newsitem.title: USA: Brazil's Malan confident CVRD will be privatized.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Malan confident CVRD will be privatized.

text.p: Brazilian Finance Minister Pedro Malan said on Tuesday he was confident that Brazil will be able to privatize the giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) mining company.

Malan blamed the delay in the auction, scheduled for earlier on Tuesday, on a flurry of lawsuits filed in Brazilian courts to try to halt the sale of 45 percent of CVRD's voting shares on Rio de Janeiro's stock exchange.
"But we are confident that it will be privatized, sooner or later," he told reporters at a news conference on the fringes of the International Monetary Fund/World Bank spring meeting.
Asked when the sale might actually go ahead, the minister replied: "I do not have a crystal ball."
Brazil could raise about $5 billion if it manages to privatize all of CVRD, the world's largest iron ore exporter.
The Brazilian government has deployed a battalion of lawyers to fly to cities and towns to fight injunctions against the privatization.
The privatization is a test of confidence in the Brazilian economy for foreign investors.
